meta.title: EnglishLearn — English that adapts to you
meta.description: An AI that finds your exact weak spots and trains them — not another one-size-fits-all course. Start with a free diagnostic.

hero.title: English that trains your weak spots, not everyone’s.
hero.subtitle: Most courses teach the same lessons to everyone. EnglishLearn starts by finding exactly where you struggle — then builds every session around closing that gap.

program.title: Next session
program.focus: Present Perfect: the rule, then practice
program.review: Past Simple: review when it’s due

problem.title: You already know some of this. Why study it again?
problem.body: Generic courses waste your time on what you’ve mastered and rush past what you haven’t. The result: hours spent, little moved. EnglishLearn flips it — we measure your level per skill, then spend your time only where it counts.

values.title: Built around one idea: practice what you actually need.

gaps.title: AI that finds your gaps
gaps.body: A short diagnostic maps your English across grammar and vocabulary. From the first session, practice is aimed at your weakest areas — and it keeps recalibrating as you improve.

adapt.title: Practice that adapts in real time
adapt.body: Every answer updates what you see next. Struggle with a concept and it comes back sooner; master it and you move on. No fixed syllabus to grind through.

progress.title: Progress you can actually read
progress.body: Every grammar topic carries its CEFR level and moves through plain stages — Emerging, Developing, Solid, Secure — while each word goes from New to Mastered. See what’s improving and what still needs work, never raw scores.

howItWorks.title: From “where am I?” to steady progress in three steps.

diagnostic.title: Take the diagnostic
diagnostic.body: A quick assessment places your level in grammar and vocabulary. Around five minutes.

practice.title: Practice your gaps
practice.body: The AI serves exercises aimed at your weak spots and spaces out review so it sticks. Difficulty shifts with you.

progress.title: Watch your topics move
progress.body: Each grammar topic and each word moves through plain stages as you practice, so improvement is visible — and the plan updates as you go.

finalCta.title: Find out where your English actually stands.
finalCta.subtitle: Five minutes. No card. A clear picture of your level — and a plan to move it.

impressum.title: Legal notice
impressum.disclaimerText: We prepare the content of this site with care but cannot guarantee that it is complete, correct or up to date. We are not responsible for the content of external sites we link to; their operators are.

datenschutz.title: Privacy policy
datenschutz.intro: We process only the personal data needed to run your account and your learning: your email address, your name if you give one, your answers and your learning progress. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

processors.vercel: Vercel — hosting and delivery of the website.
processors.neon: Neon — database that stores your account and learning progress.
processors.resend: Resend — sending account emails, such as password reset links.
processors.sentry: Sentry — error monitoring, so we can find and fix technical problems.

datenschutz.cookiesText: We use only strictly necessary technical cookies: one keeps you signed in, one remembers your interface language. We use no marketing, analytics or tracking cookies.
datenschutz.rightsText: Under the GDPR you have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. Write to us at the contact address in the legal notice. You may also lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Datenschutzbehörde).
